notes:
The fake backend is the only backend checked; the sim backend was not run (metaworld, MuJoCo and numpy are not installed where the gate runs, and package code never imports the clone). This package implements the first confirmed entry symbol, assembly-v3 (metaworld.envs.sawyer_assembly_peg_v3:SawyerNutAssemblyEnvV3); the other four card entry symbols are separate tasks and are named in facts.md. The fake is a pure-Python kinematic stand-in: it has no contacts, rigid-body dynamics, gripper or object motion and was not compared with the upstream environment; it returns the declared 39-element observation, so no smaller array is substituted. No hardware was attached and no human reviewed or tested anything. Accepted warnings from the last gate run: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the bridge records the seed, but upstream SawyerXYZEnv.reset ignores it), G7.MAYBE_ABSENT for observation_space (SawyerMocapBase inherits it from gymnasium's external MujocoEnv, so the name is not in the clone's class AST), and four G8.NO_UNIT warnings for the bridge-derived inputs ticks, action.values[*] and seed (twice). There were no G4 warnings. No site-limits.example.json is needed because the driver declares no operator-required bound.
